# Installation {#sec-installation}

## Review workstation

**Prerequisites:** Windows or Linux host, Python 3.11 or 3.12, Node.js/npm, and optional DICOM extras when DICOM input is required.

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/siriponsri/dr-support-screening-poc.git
cd dr-support-screening-poc
py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e ".[test,dicom]"
npm ci
cd frontend
npm ci
npm run build
cd ..
START.cmd
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/app/`. The review launcher uses `APP_PROFILE=review` and `MODEL_RUNTIME=remote`. Set `REMOTE_MODEL_URL` and the optional `REMOTE_MODEL_TOKEN` outside Git before starting when a Model API is available.

## Linux server checkout

Place the release at `/opt/dr-support-screening-poc` when using the included systemd unit. Keep runtime assets in `local-state/` or another private path. Never commit model weights, review databases, or secret environment files.

## Configuration

Copy `.env.example` only as a reference. Use private process environment or an approved secret manager for tokens. The model-server example is [deployment/model-server.env.example](../../deployment/model-server.env.example). See [Configuration](../CONFIGURATION.md) for the complete variable matrix.
